_comment: Texts of the Apple apps only: prefix ios_ for what Android says differently or does not have, prefix macos_ for what only the Mac app says. Merged into Localizable.xcstrings by strings-from-android.py; same tone (English, plain "you").
ios_create_camera_unavailable: No camera available here. Paste or enter the installation key.
ios_debug_departure: Demo: simulate the server on departure
ios_debug_enter_demo_hint: Debug build only. Bypasses pairing (no network, demo data) and opens the feed. Otherwise, enter any code (e.g. 7-crayon-lune): the demo verification code is 482913.
ios_debug_simulate_later: Simulate a hidden item in 5 s (notification)
ios_devices_add_reason: Add a device to your space
ios_devices_add_unavailable: Set up a screen lock (passcode or biometrics) to add a device to your space.
ios_devices_revoke_reason: Remove a device from your space
ios_notif_device_added_body: %1$@ is now part of your space. Not you? Remove it from Devices.
ios_notice_files_skipped: Some files were not attached: 25 MB maximum per file, 20 files at most.
ios_onboarding_headline: Add Tomi to your share favorites
ios_onboarding_step_2: 2. Scroll the row of apps to the end, then tap More.
ios_onboarding_step_3: 3. Tap Edit, then add Tomi to the favorites: it then stays at the top, in the same place.
ios_pair_camera_unavailable: No camera available here. Enter the invitation code shown on the other device.
ios_pair_error_unsupported: This version of Tomi cannot join a space yet.
ios_share_inbox_expired: A share that could not be sent for more than 7 days was deleted.
ios_share_inbox_failed: A share could not be sent. Tomi will try again.
ios_capture_cover: Hidden content is shown while the screen of this iPhone is being shared or recorded. Tomi covers it so that it does not appear in the copy.
ios_capture_cover_close: Hide and go back to the feed
ios_capture_share_blocked: The screen is being shared or recorded: hidden content cannot be shared right now.
ios_unreadable_reset_failed: Erasing failed. Try again, or delete the app and reinstall it.
ios_capture_cover_pairing: The screen of this iPhone is being shared or recorded. Tomi covers the pairing code so that it does not appear in the copy: someone who saw it could join your space.
ios_capture_step_island: Tap the sharing icon at the top of the screen, then “Stop”.
ios_capture_step_mac: Or close iPhone Mirroring on your Mac.
ios_capture_step_record: Or stop the screen recording in Control Center.
ios_capture_resume: Tomi resumes by itself as soon as the sharing stops.
ios_file_preview_none: This type of file cannot be shown here. Open it in an app that can read it.
ios_file_hidden: A hidden file is not shown in Tomi: its preview would escape the screen protection. You can share it to another app after Face ID.
ios_file_load_failed: Couldn’t open this file. Try again in a moment.
ios_relay_revoked_admin: %1$@ was removed by the administrator of the relay.
ios_relay_revoked_other: %1$@ was removed from your space by the relay.
ios_relay_revoked_self: %1$@ left your space, according to the relay.
ios_rotation_stalled_body: A removed device may still hold the current key of your space. Tomi retries automatically; open Tomi on your other devices to help.
macos_status_unread: Tomi, some received items are unread
macos_settings_login_hint: Without this, nothing is received after a restart until you open Tomi.
macos_settings_shortcut_hint: Opens Tomi from any app; press it again to close it.
macos_settings_shortcut_refused: This shortcut is already taken (by another app or by Tomi’s other shortcut). The previous one is kept.
macos_settings_notifications_hint: When an item arrives and Tomi is not open in front of you.
macos_settings_notifications_denied: Denied by macOS: nothing is shown when an item arrives. Allow Tomi in System Settings, Notifications.
ios_misconfigured_title: This version of Tomi is not signed correctly
ios_misconfigured_body: It is denied access to the system Keychain, so Tomi cannot open its data. Nothing is damaged or erased: install a version signed with the app’s identifier.
macos_settings_downloads_hint: Where the files you save from Tomi go.
_mac_comment: The Mac wording of texts shared with the phones (strings-from-android.py): _mac_replacements are applied to every text, _mac gives a whole text.
macos_settings_send_shortcut_hint: From any app: copies what is selected there (text, files, image) and opens Send in Tomi with it.
macos_settings_copy_selection_denied: To copy the selection, macOS must allow Tomi (System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility). Without this, the shortcut opens Send without copying anything.

_mac.biometric_subtitle_delete_space: This cannot be undone: Touch ID or this Mac’s password is required.
_mac.biometric_subtitle_erase: This cannot be undone: Touch ID or this Mac’s password is required.
_mac.biometric_subtitle_revoke: Sensitive action: Touch ID or this Mac’s password is required.
_mac.delete_space_unavailable_biometric: To delete your space, Touch ID or this Mac’s password is needed. Nothing has been erased.
_mac.erase_unavailable_biometric: To erase without confirmation from the server, Touch ID or this Mac’s password is needed.
_mac.devices_revoke_message: This device will be removed from the space and the space key will be renewed. It will no longer be able to read new items. You will be asked for Touch ID or this Mac’s password.
_mac.devices_revoke_unavailable: Neither Touch ID nor this Mac’s password can be used: revoking is not possible.
_mac.detail_masked_hint: Show, Copy and Share require Touch ID or this Mac’s password.
_mac.detail_revealed_hint: Hides again after a few seconds, and as soon as you leave Tomi.
_mac.toast_biometric_unavailable: Neither Touch ID nor this Mac’s password can be used: hidden content cannot be shown, copied or shared.
_mac.feed_empty_archives: No archived items. Archive an item from its “⋯” menu.
_mac.invite_verify_hint: If the other device shows an error instead of a code, click “They are different”.
_mac.pair_link_received_hint: Nothing is done automatically. Click “Join” to continue.
_mac.snackbar_image_saved: Image saved to your save folder
_mac.ios_file_hidden: A hidden file is not shown in Tomi: its preview would escape the screen protection. You can share it to another app after Touch ID or this Mac’s password.
_mac.ios_onboarding_headline: Tomi lives in your menu bar
_mac.ios_onboarding_step_1: 1. Click the Tomi icon, near the clock: your feed opens.
_mac.ios_onboarding_step_2: 2. From any app, ⌃⇧Space opens Tomi. Select a text or files, then press ⌃⇧V: Send opens with your selection. Send it (⌘↩).
_mac.ios_onboarding_step_3: 3. Tomi opens at login, to receive even with its windows closed. The shortcut and this choice can be changed in Settings.
_mac.ios_clip_hint: Clipboard · Tab to use it, or send directly
_mac.biometric_subtitle_pair: The new device will receive the whole history, hidden items included. Confirm with Touch ID or this Mac’s password.
_mac.invite_auth_required_body: To add a device, confirm your identity with Touch ID or this Mac’s password.

_system.NSCameraUsageDescription: Tomi uses the camera only to scan the pairing QR code.
_system.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Tomi asks for Face ID before showing, copying or sharing a hidden item.
_system.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Tomi saves to Photos the images you choose to add there.

_system_mac.NSCameraUsageDescription: Tomi uses the camera only to scan a QR code: the one of a device to join, or the one of an installation key.
